title: HDBS 2026 Puja Registration Guidelines & Sponsorship Privileges
extractedMarkdown:
### HOUSTON DURGA BARI SOCIETY - 2026 PUJA REGISTRATION & SPONSORSHIP
Official Source: https://durgabari.org/2026-puja/registration/

🚫 DAY PASSES POLICY:
- Single-day passes are NOT sold. There are no daily tickets for Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.
- Temple entry for darshan, prayer, floral Pushpanjali, and witnessing Arati is completely FREE and open to all devotees without passes or tickets.
- Registration provides badges for access to cultural programs in Sur Auditorium and dining.

📝 REGISTRATION OPTIONS:
- Puja Choices: Register by Puja (Durga Puja, Kali Puja, Saraswati Puja, or All 3 Pujas bundle).
- Price Types: Family Registration or Individual Registration.
- Categories: Member (Returning User), Non-Member (New User), Out-of-Towner (eligible for Member rates with address proof), Full-Time Student (with student ID).
- Senior Discount: 70+ years (Primary registrant & spouse).
- Children: Above 22 register separately (relaxed to 26 if unmarried student/unemployed).

🅿️ SPONSORSHIP & ASSIGNED PARKING (501(c)(3)):
- Diamond ($5,000+): Main Parking (Named slots for $10K)
- Emerald ($2,200 – $4,999): Main Parking
- Platinum ($1,500 – $2,199): Kala Bhavan (KB) Parking
- Gold ($1,000 – $1,499): Green Field Parking (KB for CT Gold)
- Silver ($750 – $999): Green Field Parking (KB for CT Senior Silver; courtesy visiting parent registration)
- Benefactor ($400+ General / $200+ Senior): Green Field Parking Application
Online Portal: https://durgabari.org/2026-puja/registration/ | Contact: registration@durgabari.org

### HDBS 2026 PUJA PARKING & BUS SHUTTLE SCHEDULE (OFFICIAL FLYER)
Source: https://durgabari.org/2026-puja/parking-bus-schedule/

#### 1. Off-Site Parking & Shuttle Transportation:
- **Location**: WEST OAKS MALL
- **Address**: 1000 West Oaks Mall #800, Houston, TX 77082
- **Landmark**: Near Dillard's Clearance Center
- **Features**: FREE Parking, On-site security, Shuttle bus transportation to/from Durga Bari

#### 2. Shuttle Bus Timetable:
- **Durga Puja Schedule**:
  - Friday, Oct 16: 5:00 pm – 12:30 am
  - Saturday, Oct 17: 9:00 am – 12:30 am
  - Sunday, Oct 18: 9:00 am – 10:30 pm
  - Saturday, Oct 24: 2:00 pm – 12:30 am
- **Kali Puja Schedule**:
  - Saturday, Nov 7: 5:00 pm – 12:30 am
  - Sunday, Nov 8: 5:00 pm – 10:30 pm

#### 3. On-Premises Parking & Decal Rules:
- "To park on the premises, all cars must have the approved DECAL clearly affixed to the windshield."
- Reserved exclusively for authorized permit holders, seniors, and VIP sponsors.

#### 4. Traffic, Rideshare & City Parking Advisory:
- **Uber / Rideshare**: Pick-up and drop-off allowed (no waiting) via Schiller Rd.
- **City Parking**: NOT managed by HDBS / Security team. Avoid parking over 1 hour. HDBS is not answerable to HPD queries.
- **Disabled Parking**: Limited state-law spots on First-Come First-Served basis. Once full, drop-offs only. Vehicles with Green Field decals proceed to Green Field.
